items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Our first night in the Apple, we had dinner with a Swiss friend, named Peter Wydler and his wife Othella. I was their best man when they married in Paris, France in 1949.

ctx.x: We stayed in New York for 6 days and heard Red Allen, Roy Eldridge, Charlie Shavers, Buster Bailey, Cozy Cole, Claude Hopkins, Coleman Hawkins, Sol Yegar, Russel "Big Chief" Moore and the bassist, Benny Moten at different times when we visited the Metropole on 7th Avenue near Broadway. I didn't find much change in New York from the last time I saw it, but friends told us that there were improvements in the racial relations.

Our first night in the Apple, we had dinner with a Swiss friend, named Peter Wydler and his wife Othella. I was their best man when they married in Paris, France in 1949. Othella, who was American, was a dancer in Catherine Dunham's show which was touring in Europe and Miss Dunham was bridesmaid for Othella and Peter's marriage.
We had dinner another time with Arvell Shaw and his wife, Madeleine who is also Swiss. With Peter and Madeleine Shaw being Swiss, Lily was with some of her homeland people.
